params.name: provider_ids
params.description: Filter by one or more providers. Requires workspace_token.

params.name: billing_account_ids
params.description: Filter by billing account identifiers. Requires workspace_token.

params.name: account_ids
params.description: Filter by account identifiers. Requires workspace_token.

params.name: regions
params.description: Filter by region slugs (e.g. us-east-1, eastus, asia-east1). Requires workspace_token.

params.name: tag_key
params.description: Filter by tag key (must be used with tag_value). Requires workspace_token.

params.name: tag_value
params.description: Filter by tag value (requires tag_key). Requires workspace_token.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Filter recommendations created on/after this YYYY-MM-DD date. Requires workspace_token.

params.name: end_date
params.description: Filter recommendations created on/before this YYYY-MM-DD date. Requires workspace_token.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by status.

params.name: min_savings
params.description: Filter by recommendations whose potential savings are greater than or equal to this amount, in the workspace's currency. Requires workspace_token.

params.name: page
params.description: The page of results to return.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of results to return. The maximum is 1000.

params.name: workspace_token
params.description: Filter by workspace.

params.name: provider_account_id
params.description: Filter by provider account id (AWS account, Azure subscription id, etc).

params.name: category
params.description: Filter by exact recommendation category. Ignored when type is provided.

params.name: type
params.description: Fuzzy filter by recommendation type using a case-insensitive literal substring. Examples: aws, aws:ec2, aws:ec2:rightsizing.

params.name: provider
params.description: Filter by provider.

items.docs: Return all Recommendations. Use the `type` query parameter with a fuzzy fragment to filter recommendation type case-insensitively (for example: aws, aws:ec2, aws:ec2:rightsizing).
